packages.title: Defra — Download industrial emissions and waste transfer UK PRTR data — scope and status QA
facts: The official source scope is UK PRTR annual industrial emissions and waste-transfer datasets.
The cited publication or update date is 2026-06-30.
Defra publishes the 2024 UK PRTR dataset as an XML reporting-year dataset.
The PRTR covers industrial emissions and waste transfers and is facility/reporting-system evidence.
Handling boundary: PRTR facility records are not automatically cadastral parcel emissions.

facts: The official source scope is Announcement for the 2025 DUKES annual energy-statistics release.
The cited publication or update date is 2026-07-19.
The announcement lists a confirmed release date of 30 July 2026 for the 2025 DUKES publication.
On 25 July 2026 that release date is still in the future and the announced release must not be treated as observed data.
Handling boundary: future publication announcements must not be used as if the dataset were already released.
